1. identityConsistency: 2 - Players are reduced to indistinct colored blobs, losing all structural detail, limb definition, and kit/number information.
2. motionFidelity: 3 - The subtle positional shifts of the color blobs between frames are consistent with the expected movement over a short time interval.
3. stylizationStrength: 4 - The heavy Kuwahara filtering creates a very obvious and uniform painterly abstraction across the entire scene.
